info.title: V-Intern API
info.description: V-INTERN learning platform: sequential recruitment chat, versioned project libraries, owned sessions, AI draft/publish, task submissions, per-user GitHub OAuth, immutable code evidence, instructor approval and final review decisions. AI proposals never replace backend authorization or final instructor decisions. Includes performance, report snapshots/PDF/XLSX, KPI, virtual salary and certificate verification. Bearer JWT; rotating HttpOnly refresh cookie at /api/v1/auth.
